Desastre!
El encargado Marcelo, no permitió pasar al baño, ya siendo cliente y socio del ACA.
por queja del personal.
La verdad bochornoso, no lo irrespetuoso, y altanero. No terminamos mal, porque soy educado, porque el petiso se merecía una un buen golpe

(Translated by Google)
Disaster!
The manager, Marcelo, wouldn't let me use the restroom, even though I was a customer and member of the ACA.

This was due to a staff complaint.
It was truly shameful, not just disrespectful, but arrogant. We didn't end up in a bad situation because I'm polite; the short guy deserved a good punch.
